national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi today said that service should be the main purpose of life and must be inherent in every individual. He said that in politics too, service should remain the guiding principle, even when one reaches the highest position. Mr Modi made these remarks during a virtual interaction with Seva Yatris travelling on the Yatra from Vadnagar to Varanasi. The Prime Minister said, ‘Seva Paramo Dharma’ service is the highest duty should remain the guiding principle. Mr Modi said, service is the biggest driving force. He said, whether it is PM-KISAN or the PM Surya Ghar Yojana, countless such schemes are recognised for their last-mile delivery. The Prime Minister said, it is only when there is a spirit of service, four crore poor have receive permanent houses. He said, when the spirit of service is integrated into a nation’s policies, service itself becomes the greatest driving force for the country’s progress. Mr Modi said, it gives rise to innovative schemes that bring out 25 crore citizens from the cycle of poverty. He said, politics, elections, and systems of governance have their own place. The Prime Minister said, we are people dedicated to nation-building and set out with the resolve to build a developed India. He said, everyone must vigorously advance the pivotal role of the youth in building a developed India by 2047. Mr Modi said, today’s young generation is both the architect of a developed India and the one that will be a major beneficiary of it. During the interaction, Seva Yatris shared their experiences with the Prime Minister. They said that they planted saplings and conducted cleanliness drives as part of the campaign. They added that during the yatra, they interacted with people and received their positive feedback on the benefits of various government schemes.

national_raw_news.title: President Murmu, Vice President, PM Modi congratulate Roshibina Devi, Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on Asian Games medals 3 hours ago 68
national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated Roshibina Devi Naorem on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 60kg Sanda event in wushu at the Asian Games 2026. In a social media post, the president said winning three medals at three consecutive Asian Games is a remarkable achievement and historic milestone for Indian Wushu. Murmu added that their inspiring journey continues with many more proud moments. She also congratulated Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on winning the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Double Sculls at the Asian Games 2026. She said that their performance reflects the strength of teamwork, endurance and commitment that rowing demands. Murmu added that both continue to achieve greater heights. President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated the Indian Men’s Badminton Team on winning Bronze Medal at the Asian Games 2026. In a social media post, the President said, this commendable achievement reflects the team’s determination, resilience and fighting spirit. President Murmu added that each member made a valuable contribution to this proud success. Vice President C P Radhakrishnan also congratulated Roshibina Devi Naorem on securing the Silver Medal in the Women’s 60kg Sanda event at the Asian Games 2026. He also congratulated Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on winning the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Double Sculls event in the Games. In a social media post, Mr Radhakrishnan said that Roshibina’s 3rd consecutive Asian Games medal marks a historic milestone for Indian Wushu. He also noted that Satnam and Salman’s podium finish reflects exceptional teamwork and endurance. The Vice President said that they may continue to bring many more moments of pride to the nation. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also congratulated Naorem Roshibina Devi on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Sanda 60kg event at the Asian Games. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that winning medals at three consecutive Asian Games is a remarkable achievement. He said that Naorem Roshibina’s consistency, courage and determination are truly commendable. Mr Modi congratulated Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on winning the bronze medal in the Men’s Double Sculls at the Asian Games. In a social media post, he said that the performance by both athletes has earned India a well-deserved medal. Prime Minister Modi said that their composure and coordination stood out. He stated that this accomplishment will serve as motivation for them to attain even greater heights in the year ahead.

national_raw_news.title: Mizoram launches first ‘Pluck & Pay’ festival to boost rural tourism 23 mins ago 14
national_raw_news.content: Mizoram has launched its first ‘Pluck & Pay’ festival in Khawzawl district in the eastern part of the state, offering visitors an opportunity to harvest farm produce themselves and pay farmers directly as the state seeks to expand tourism-led livelihood opportunities in rural communities, officials said. The three-day festival, being held from September 23 to 25 at Tualte and Chawngtlai villages, has been jointly organised by the state Tourism department and the office of the Khawzawl Deputy Commissioner. The initiative brings agriculture, horticulture, tourism, local food and community enterprise together, allowing visitors to experience rural life while creating direct economic linkages with farming households, officials said. Tourism Minister Lalnghinglova Hmar said the initiative reflected the state’s broader vision of ensuring that tourism benefits the communities hosting visitors. “The future of tourism is not only about taking visitors to places; it is about creating value for the people who make those places worth visiting,” he said, adding that the government wanted stronger linkages between tourism and villages, farms, entrepreneurs and cultural communities. Besides farm visits and harvesting, the festival features traditional Mizo music and dance, local cuisine, handicrafts, cultural performances and traditional recreational games, besides visits to historical and tourist sites. The initiative is aimed at creating an ecosystem in which tourism spending can also support local farmers, homestays, guides, transport operators, artisans and other community-based enterprises. The launch marks the beginning of Mizoram’s 2026 festival season, with the Anthurium Festival at Reiek, Hnahsin Kût in Champhai and Travel Fest in Aizawl among the events lined up in the coming months. Leitlangpui Music Festival, Winter Festival, Tlaizawng Paradise Festival and Sakawrhmuituai Sunset Event are also scheduled as part of the wider tourism calendar. Official figures presented during the recent state assembly session showed tourist arrivals rising from 4,27,302 in 2024 to 8,41,322 in 2025. The ‘Pluck & Pay’ initiative seeks to leverage this growing visitor base to increase the participation of rural communities in the state’s tourism economy, officials added.
